description: Decode any Solana transaction into plain language: type (swap, transfer, NFT sale, mint ...), the program or DEX used, who sent what to whom with token symbols and amounts, SOL balance changes, fee and status. Lets an agent confirm a payment or audit what a wallet did. Price: 0.003 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. Free sample answer: get_example {"tool":"solana_tx_explain"}.
